text: everyone go for the Grey Mother
hurl the loose rocks down on the Pale wolf
kick the loose rocks down the rise onto the Grey Mother
grab the torch and fling it at the Grey Mother
light the hay bale and push it toward the den
smoke the wolves out of their den with burning hay
charge up the rise at the Grey Mother
Pip, draw the Torn-ear wolf off to the right
hunker down behind the fallen log

grab one of the cubs to draw the Grey Mother out
